idea-plugin.name: Hailuo MCP
idea-plugin.description:
AI Video Generation with Hailuo (MiniMax) via Model Context Protocol (MCP).

This plugin helps you set up the MCP Hailuo (MiniMax) server with JetBrains AI Assistant. Once configured, AI Assistant can generate videos from text and images — all powered by Ace Data Cloud.

Features

  • 6 AI Tools — Generate videos from text and images
  • Easy Setup — One-click copy MCP configuration for AI Assistant
  • Dual Mode — STDIO (local) and HTTP (remote) server support
  • Token Management — Store API token securely in IDE settings

Available Tools

  • Text to Video — Create videos from text prompts
  • Image to Video — Generate videos from reference images
  • Director Mode — Image-to-video with enhanced creative control
  • Task Tracking — Monitor generation progress and retrieve results

Quick Start

  1. Install this plugin
  2. Open Settings → Tools → Hailuo MCP
  3. Enter your Ace Data Cloud API token
  4. Click Copy Config and paste into Settings → Tools → AI Assistant → MCP

Requires uv (Python package runner) for STDIO mode, or use HTTP mode for zero-install remote access.

Get your Ace Data Cloud API key

Sign in to Applications and open General Application. If it is missing, select Initialize General Application. Click the copy button marked 1 beside API KEY.

Store the raw key in your client’s credential store or in the environment variable shown below. Add Bearer only when setting an HTTP Authorization header yourself. Check access to the required operations, the current pricing, and the application balance. To use a separate key for this integration, open Manage Keys to set Allowed APIs, expiration, and usage limit.
